description_en: Invokes the DeleteBasicAccelerator operation to delete a specified basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用DeleteBasicAccelerator接口删除指定的基础型全球加速实例
kebab_example: aliyun ga delete-basic-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBasicAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id
